theme.subheader: Choose between the light and dark appearance for the whole application.

commander.subheader: It enables users to quickly search, navigate, and execute actions through a keyboard-driven interface, triggered by shortcuts like Ctrl + K

update.subheader: Here you can update configurations for User Interface, like menu, commander, connection editor.

customTheme.title: Custom theme
customTheme.description: Pick your four main colors — primary, accent, neutral tone and sidebar. A full light and dark theme is generated from them and added to the theme list.

systemTheme.description: Save these colors as the system theme so every user gets them by default. Anyone who picked a theme of their own keeps it.
systemTheme.saved: System theme saved for all users
systemTheme.saveFailed: The system theme could not be saved
systemTheme.resetFailed: The system theme could not be reset
systemTheme.personalOverride: You are viewing a theme of your own, which hides the system theme on this screen. Other users still see the system theme.

confirmReset.title: Reset system theme?
confirmReset.message: The saved colors are deleted and every user falls back to the default theme. Users with a theme of their own are not affected.
